title: China-to-Oman Power Tool Compliance Gap Matrix
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.requirement: Electrical Safety for Mains and Charger Equipment
rows.target_requirement: Oman applies GSO standards that adopt the IEC 62841 series for hand-held, transportable, and garden motor-operated electric tools, with electrical safety verified through Oman national conformity managed by MOCIIP and the DGSM. Tools, chargers, external power supplies, and adapters must be safe at the local 240 V, 50 Hz supply; the 50 Hz frequency matches China but the nominal voltage differs from China's 220/380 V, so voltage-dependent ratings and markings must suit Oman.
target_standards: GSO IEC 62841 series adopted as GSO standards for motor-operated electric tools
Oman national conformity (MOCIIP / DGSM) for in-scope electrical products
GSO IEC 60335-1 / charger and external power-supply standards where applicable
rows.china_equivalent: China power-tool safety files commonly use the GB/T 3883 series for hand-held motor-operated electric tools, with CCC certification where the product is in the compulsory catalogue and separate charger standards where applicable. GB/T 3883 evidence is technically close to IEC 62841 but does not by itself satisfy Oman national conformity, the local 240 V rating context, or DGSM documentation.
china_standards: CCC certification where the product is in the compulsory catalogue
China charger safety standards where applicable
rows.gap: The common gap is presenting a GB/T 3883 report and CCC mark as if they were Oman acceptance. The exporter should map GB/T 3883 evidence to the GSO/IEC 62841 standard adopted in Oman, confirm ratings and markings for 240 V, 50 Hz, separately address the charger or external power supply, and route the package through Oman national conformity under MOCIIP and the DGSM.

target.en: Mandatory: electrical safety conformity for in-scope tools, chargers, and power supplies via Oman national conformity (MOCIIP / DGSM) against the adopted GSO/IEC 62841 standards. The specific GSO/IEC standard is the technical reference invoked by that conformity requirement.
target.zh: 强制：适用工具、充电器和电源须通过阿曼国家符合性评定（MOCIIP / DGSM），按采纳的 GSO/IEC 62841 标准证明电气安全符合性。具体 GSO/IEC 标准是该符合性要求所援引的技术参照。
target.zht: 強制：適用工具、充電器和電源須通過阿曼國家符合性評定（MOCIIP / DGSM），按採納的 GSO/IEC 62841 標準證明電氣安全符合性。具體 GSO/IEC 標準是該符合性要求所援引的技術參照。

cn.en: China domestic baseline commonly uses GB/T 3883 series, with CCC certification where the tool is in the compulsory catalogue.
cn.zh: 中国境内基线通常采用 GB/T 3883 系列，凡工具列入强制目录则须取得 CCC 认证。
cn.zht: 中國境內基線通常採用 GB/T 3883 系列，凡工具列入強制目錄則須取得 CCC 認證。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Conditionally non-compliant until GB/T 3883 evidence is mapped to the adopted GSO/IEC 62841 standard, ratings and markings suit 240 V 50 Hz, the charger or external power supply is addressed separately, and the package clears Oman national conformity under MOCIIP and the DGSM.

rows.target_requirement: Oman applies GSO EMC standards, which adopt the IEC/CISPR EMC framework, to motor-driven tools, electronic speed controllers, chargers, and power supplies. The product must not generate excessive electromagnetic disturbance and must have adequate immunity, and EMC results are reviewed within Oman national conformity managed by MOCIIP and the DGSM. Where a cordless tool contains a radio module, EMC review sits alongside separate TRA radio approval.
target_standards: GSO EMC standards adopting IEC / CISPR EMC framework
Oman national conformity (MOCIIP / DGSM) review of EMC evidence
TRA radio approval for cordless tools with a wireless module [separate from EMC]
rows.china_equivalent: China compliance packages may include GB EMC reports alongside GB/T 3883 safety reports. Test limits, configuration, worst-case operating modes, charger inclusion, and declaration wording still need Oman-specific review against the adopted GSO EMC standards.
china_standards: China GB EMC standards and test reports where applicable
rows.gap: A frequent gap is a report that tests only the bare tool but omits the charger, battery pack, electronic controller variants, or worst-case load conditions, and is not mapped to the GSO EMC limits Oman recognises. The conformity file should show the exact marketed configuration and the adopted GSO/CISPR limits.

target.en: Mandatory: EMC conformity for in-scope apparatus under the adopted GSO EMC standards, reviewed within Oman national conformity (MOCIIP / DGSM). Radio modules additionally trigger separate TRA approval.
target.zh: 强制：适用设备须按采纳的 GSO EMC 标准证明电磁兼容符合性，并在阿曼国家符合性评定（MOCIIP / DGSM）中审查。射频模块另须取得单独的 TRA 核准。
target.zht: 強制：適用設備須按採納的 GSO EMC 標準證明電磁相容符合性，並在阿曼國家符合性評定（MOCIIP / DGSM）中審查。射頻模組另須取得單獨的 TRA 核准。

cn.en: China domestic files may include GB EMC evidence, but Oman acceptance depends on scope, limits, configuration, and mapping to the adopted GSO standards.
cn.zh: 中国境内文件可包含 GB EMC 证据，但阿曼接受性取决于范围、限值、配置及与采纳 GSO 标准的映射。
cn.zht: 中國境內文件可包含 GB EMC 證據，但阿曼接受性取決於範圍、限值、配置及與採納 GSO 標準的映射。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Oman-ready until EMC evidence covers the actual marketed tool system, is mapped to the adopted GSO EMC limits, and clears Oman national conformity under MOCIIP and the DGSM, with TRA approval handled separately for any radio module.

rows.requirement: Market Access Under Oman National Conformity
rows.target_requirement: Electric and cordless power tools placed on the Omani market are subject to Oman national conformity and registration managed by MOCIIP and the DGSM, which apply GSO standards adopting the IEC 62841 series. Imports arrive mainly through Sohar and Salalah, where conformity documentation is checked. Cordless tools with a wireless module additionally require TRA type approval, and labour-use aspects sit under the Ministry of Labour occupational framework. The legal conformity obligation is mandatory; GSO/IEC 62841 is the technical reference.
target_standards: Oman national conformity and registration (MOCIIP / DGSM)
GSO standards adopting IEC 62841 series [technical reference]
TRA type approval for cordless tools with a wireless module
Ministry of Labour occupational framework for workplace use
rows.china_equivalent: China power-tool safety files commonly reference the GB/T 3883 series for hand-held motor-operated electric tools, transportable tools, and garden machinery, with CCC certification where applicable. GB/T 3883 and CCC evidence do not replace Oman national conformity, DGSM registration, the importer documentation package, or TRA radio approval.
rows.gap: A China domestic safety report is not enough for Oman placement. The importer needs an Oman conformity certificate or registration via MOCIIP and the DGSM, a conformity documentation package mapped to the adopted GSO/IEC 62841 standards, correct 240 V 50 Hz markings, and TRA approval for any wireless module, with port clearance at Sohar or Salalah.

target.en: Mandatory: Oman national conformity and registration under MOCIIP and the DGSM, applying GSO standards that adopt IEC 62841; TRA type approval is mandatory for cordless tools with a wireless module. GSO/IEC 62841 is the technical reference, not a standalone legal act.
target.zh: 强制：由 MOCIIP 与 DGSM 管理的阿曼国家符合性评定与注册，适用采纳 IEC 62841 的 GSO 标准；带无线模块的无绳工具须取得 TRA 型号核准。GSO/IEC 62841 为技术参照，并非独立法律文件。
target.zht: 強制：由 MOCIIP 與 DGSM 管理的阿曼國家符合性評定與註冊，適用採納 IEC 62841 的 GSO 標準；帶無線模組的無繩工具須取得 TRA 型號核准。GSO/IEC 62841 為技術參照，並非獨立法律文件。

cn.en: Mandatory China domestic baseline commonly uses GB/T 3883 series, with CCC certification for in-scope catalogue products.
cn.zh: 中国境内强制基线通常采用 GB/T 3883 系列，列入目录的产品须取得 CCC 认证。
cn.zht: 中國境內強制基線通常採用 GB/T 3883 系列，列入目錄的產品須取得 CCC 認證。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Oman-ready as-is if the product file only contains GB/T 3883 and CCC evidence. Oman national conformity and registration via MOCIIP and the DGSM, mapping to the adopted GSO/IEC 62841 standards, 240 V 50 Hz markings, and TRA approval for any wireless module are required.

source.publisher: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MOCIIP), Sultanate of Oman

rows.requirement: Noise Treatment and Absence of an Outdoor-Noise Product Marking
rows.target_requirement: Oman does not operate an EU-style outdoor-noise product marking scheme like Directive 2000/14/EC; there is no mandatory guaranteed sound-power level marking or conformity-assessment route attached to power tools as a product condition. Noise is instead addressed indirectly through the Ministry of Labour occupational framework for workplace exposure and through any general environmental rules, while declared noise data, when present, comes from the GSO/IEC 62841 test method as product information rather than a separate marking obligation.
target_standards: No Oman equivalent to EU Directive 2000/14/EC outdoor-noise product marking
Ministry of Labour occupational framework for workplace noise exposure
GSO/IEC 62841 declared noise emission data [product information, not a marking obligation]
rows.china_equivalent: China GB/T 3883 evidence focuses on electrical and mechanical hazards and may report noise emission values measured under the tool standard, but does not provide an EU-style guaranteed sound-power marking. For Oman this is broadly aligned, since Oman also has no product-level outdoor-noise marking, so noise is not a separate market-access blocker.
china_standards: China domestic noise measurement provisions within the tool standard where applicable
rows.gap: Unlike the EU lane, there is no outdoor-noise marking gap for Oman: a China file does not need a guaranteed sound-power level or notified-body noise path to enter the Omani market. The realistic step is to keep declared noise data consistent with the GSO/IEC 62841 method and to consider workplace-exposure expectations under the Ministry of Labour framework, not a product-marking certification.

target.en: Not mandatory as a product marking: Oman has no outdoor-noise product marking equivalent to Directive 2000/14/EC. Workplace noise exposure may be addressed under the Ministry of Labour occupational framework, which applies to use rather than to product placement.
target.zh: 作为产品标识非强制：阿曼没有相当于指令 2000/14/EC 的户外噪声产品标识。工作场所噪声暴露可能由阿曼劳动部职业框架处理，该框架针对使用而非产品投放。
target.zht: 作為產品標識非強制：阿曼沒有相當於指令 2000/14/EC 的戶外噪聲產品標識。工作場所噪聲暴露可能由阿曼勞動部職業框架處理，該框架針對使用而非產品投放。

cn.en: China GB/T 3883 reports may include measured noise values, but there is no separate mandatory product noise-marking certificate.
cn.zh: 中国 GB/T 3883 报告可包含实测噪声数值，但没有单独的强制产品噪声标识证书。
cn.zht: 中國 GB/T 3883 報告可包含實測噪聲數值，但沒有單獨的強制產品噪聲標識證書。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Generally not a market-access blocker for Oman, because there is no outdoor-noise product marking equivalent to the EU scheme; keep declared noise data consistent with GSO/IEC 62841 and treat workplace exposure under the Ministry of Labour framework rather than as a product certification.

source.publisher: Ministry of Labour, Sultanate of Oman

rows.target_requirement: Oman addresses hazardous substances in electrical and electronic equipment mainly through GSO restricted-substances standards modelled on the international RoHS approach, reviewed within Oman national conformity managed by MOCIIP and the DGSM. Power tools, chargers, and electronic accessories should hold material-declaration documentation covering restricted substances and exemption logic; there is no separate EU-style RoHS declaration of conformity, so evidence is consolidated into the Oman conformity package.
target_standards: GSO restricted-substances standards based on the international RoHS approach
Oman national conformity (MOCIIP / DGSM) review of material documentation
IEC 63000-type material technical documentation [voluntary technical route]
rows.china_equivalent: China RoHS and GB/T 3883 evidence can support material and safety review, with China RoHS marking and substance declarations commonly available. For Oman this material evidence is useful, but it must be mapped to the GSO restricted-substances standard and folded into the Oman conformity documentation rather than treated as automatic acceptance.
china_standards: China RoHS requirements and substance declarations where applicable
rows.gap: The gap is usually material-traceability mapping rather than tool performance testing: homogeneous-material declarations, supplier controls, and exemption logic from the China RoHS package must be re-expressed against the GSO restricted-substances standard and included in the Oman conformity file.

target.en: Mandatory where the GSO restricted-substances standard is invoked through Oman national conformity (MOCIIP / DGSM). IEC 63000-type documentation is a voluntary technical route for assembling the evidence.
target.zh: 凡 GSO 限用物质标准经阿曼国家符合性评定（MOCIIP / DGSM）援引时为强制。IEC 63000 类文件是用于汇编证据的自愿技术路径。
target.zht: 凡 GSO 限用物質標準經阿曼國家符合性評定（MOCIIP / DGSM）援引時為強制。IEC 63000 類文件是用於彙編證據的自願技術路徑。

cn.en: China RoHS or GB/T 3883 evidence does not automatically satisfy the Oman material-documentation expectation.
cn.zh: 中国 RoHS 或 GB/T 3883 证据不会自动满足阿曼材料文件要求。
cn.zht: 中國 RoHS 或 GB/T 3883 證據不會自動滿足阿曼材料文件要求。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Oman-ready until restricted-substances material evidence is mapped to the GSO standard, exemptions are reviewed for the actual tool, charger, and accessories, and the documentation is folded into Oman national conformity under MOCIIP and the DGSM.

rows.requirement: Cordless Battery and Radio Module Obligations
rows.target_requirement: For cordless tools, Oman has no single EU Battery Regulation equivalent; lithium battery packs are addressed through GSO/IEC battery-safety standards, transport-safety rules, and the Oman conformity package, rather than an EU-style battery passport, removability, or due-diligence regime. Separately, any cordless tool that contains a wireless or radio module requires TRA type approval, which is a distinct mandatory step from the safety and conformity assessment of the tool body and battery.
target_standards: GSO / IEC lithium battery safety standards for portable battery packs
Oman national conformity (MOCIIP / DGSM) for battery-pack evidence
TRA type approval for cordless tools with a wireless or radio module
rows.china_equivalent: China tool files often treat the battery pack as an accessory tested with the tool under GB/T 3883, or under separate lithium-battery safety and transport evidence such as GB 31241 and UN 38.3. Wireless modules in China are handled under SRRC type approval. These map usefully to Oman, but the radio path must move to TRA and the battery and conformity evidence to MOCIIP and the DGSM.
china_standards: GB 31241 and UN 38.3 lithium battery safety and transport evidence where applicable
SRRC type approval for wireless modules
rows.gap: Cordless tools need two distinct things for Oman beyond tool safety: battery-pack evidence mapped to GSO/IEC battery-safety standards within the Oman conformity package, and TRA type approval for any wireless module. A China SRRC approval and domestic battery test do not transfer automatically; the exporter must obtain TRA approval and present battery evidence to MOCIIP and the DGSM.

target.en: Mandatory: TRA type approval for cordless tools with a wireless or radio module, and battery-pack safety evidence under GSO/IEC standards within Oman national conformity (MOCIIP / DGSM). There is no single EU-style battery passport or removability regime.
target.zh: 强制：带无线或射频模块的无绳工具须取得 TRA 型号核准，电池包安全证据须按 GSO/IEC 标准纳入阿曼国家符合性评定（MOCIIP / DGSM）。不存在单一欧盟式电池护照或可拆卸性制度。
target.zht: 強制：帶無線或射頻模組的無繩工具須取得 TRA 型號核准，電池包安全證據須按 GSO/IEC 標準納入阿曼國家符合性評定（MOCIIP / DGSM）。不存在單一歐盟式電池護照或可拆卸性制度。

cn.en: China tool, battery, and SRRC wireless evidence does not automatically satisfy Oman TRA approval or DGSM battery-conformity duties.
cn.zh: 中国工具、电池和 SRRC 无线证据不会自动满足阿曼 TRA 核准或 DGSM 电池符合性义务。
cn.zht: 中國工具、電池和 SRRC 無線證據不會自動滿足阿曼 TRA 核准或 DGSM 電池符合性義務。

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Not Oman-ready for cordless tools until the battery pack is mapped to GSO/IEC battery-safety standards within Oman national conformity and any wireless module holds TRA type approval, in addition to tool-body safety conformity.

source.publisher: Telecommunications Regulatory Authority (TRA), Sultanate of Oman
